source_note: 函数在任何可测集合上积分为0意味着函数几乎处处为0
english_source_note: Zero Integral on Every Measurable Set Implies Vanishing a.e.
callout_id: 函数在任何可测集合上积分为0意味着函数几乎处处为0#1
statement_en: Let $(X,\mathcal{F},\mu)$ be a measure space. If a measurable function $f:X\to \mathbb{R}$ satisfies $$\int_E f \,d\mu =0$$ for every $E \in \mathcal{F}$, then $f=0$ almost everywhere.
key_techniques: decomposition into positive and negative parts
testing the integral on level sets
prerequisites: positive and negative parts of a function
callout_body: $(X,\mathcal{F},\mu)$是一个测度空间如果可测函数$f:X\to \mathbb{R}$满足$$\int_E f \,d\mu =0 $$对任意$E \in \mathcal{F}$成立,那么$f =0$几乎处处成立。
